about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Tech Explorer & Problem Solver
about.description: A passionate tech explorer specializing in Full Stack Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science. Currently diving deep into AI Agents and Blockchain technology.

leadIn.label: WHAT I DO
leadIn.thesis: I’m interested in what happens when AI becomes part of the product: connecting models to APIs, backends, data, interfaces, and the software needed to make it useful.
leadIn.scope: Machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, and agentic applications, with hands-on work across training, inference, evaluation, experimentation, and putting models into software.
leadIn.integration: Python, APIs, databases, services, and full-stack applications: the engineering layer that carries an idea from experiment to something people can actually use.

coreEngineering.label: Core Engineering
coreEngineering.title:
Proven stack.
Measurable results.
coreEngineering.p1: I develop applied AI systems using TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, and LangChain, structuring workflows and exposing models as services through Flask and FastAPI.
coreEngineering.p2: Integrated into full-stack apps with Next.js, Express.js, and Spring Boot, backed by PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM.
coreEngineering.p3: All projects use disciplined version control, Docker containerization, and are built for stable production deployment.

profile.title: I like making AI actually work in software.
profile.narrative: I'm working toward becoming an AI engineer, with a focus on building AI-native applications that go beyond simply answering questions. Alongside that, I work with machine learning and deep learning, and explore LLMs, generative AI, and agents to understand how they can become part of useful software.
profile.narrative2: I enjoy taking those ideas from models and experiments into APIs, backends, and full-stack applications, and most of what I've learned has come from building end to end, running into things that don't work, and figuring out why until the pieces come together.

faqData.q: What engineering engagements are you open to?
faqData.a: I work on applied AI & machine learning systems, autonomous agentic runtimes, high-throughput backend services, and scalable full-stack applications. Open to engineering roles, ambitious AI technical projects, and collaborative research initiatives.

faqData.q: What is your primary technology stack?
faqData.a: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, FastAPI, Temporal, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, GCP, modern React, and TypeScript.

faqData.q: Where are you located and how do you work?
faqData.a: Based in Bengaluru, India (IST / UTC+5:30). Experienced in operating with distributed engineering teams and asynchronous communication.

faqData.q: How can we start a discussion?
faqData.a: Drop a message through the contact form, send an email directly to vivekk.codes@gmail.com, or reach out on LinkedIn / GitHub.
